desktopRequired: Desktop printing is required for direct printing
deviceRequiresDesktop: Device printing requires the Kubri Desktop app.
webPrintAvailable: Web printing remains available through the browser print dialog from an invoice or receipt.
openPreviewOnFailure: Open preview if direct print fails
sharedReceiptTemplate: Same receipt component used for printing
thermalSetupHelp: Receipt printer, roll width, calibration, and checkout behavior.
a4SetupHelp: A separate printer for full-page invoice output.

a4PreviewHelp: The actual invoice preview remains available from invoice details.
defaultsLoaded: Defaults loaded. Save changes to keep them.
settingsSaved: Printer settings saved on this device.
printerListRefreshed: Printer list refreshed. Unsaved settings were preserved.
testA4Sent: A4 test page sent to printer.
